Usage: cave [flags]

  -allow-root
    	run although the user is root: every person gets a root shell
  -config-dir folder
    	the folder of the settings, the people and the host key
  -log-level string
    	what the log has: debug, info, warn or error (default "info")
  -no-start
    	do not start the server at launch
  -page page
    	the page to show first: overview, people, attempts, connections, history, settings
  -port port
    	listen on this port for this run, whatever the settings say
  -state-dir folder
    	the folder of the attempts list, the log and the lock
  -version
    	print the version and exit

The folders, when neither a flag nor CAVE_CONFIG_DIR and CAVE_STATE_DIR name them:
  configuration  $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cave, else ~/.config/cave
  state          $XDG_STATE_HOME/cave, else ~/.local/state/cave
